// doc-repo contribution flow

Edit it. Commit it. Done.

The path every README edit takes from your browser to the live docs site — no branches to manage, no install required.

1

Open & edit

Press . on the repo page (or go to github.dev) and make your changes directly.

github.com/org/repo → .
2

Commitauto branch + PR

Main is protected, so committing prompts you to "Create a new branch and start a pull request." Just confirm — GitHub handles the rest.

3

Wait for review

An admin checks your change (including the live preview) and approves, or leaves a comment if something needs fixing.

4

Merged & live

Once approved, it's merged and the site updates automatically. Nothing else for you to do.

PRINCIPLES

💾

Commit often

Unsaved edits live only in your browser — don't sit on changes too long.

🎯

One topic per commit

Small, focused changes are easier for the admin to review.

🔒

No secrets, ever

This repo is public — never commit keys, tokens, or .env files.

🔔

Watch the repo

Turn on Watch → All Activity to know when main changes.

main is protected · direct pushes are blocked · every change is reviewed
